text.en: I am allowed to take up space.
text.my: ငါလည်း ကိုယ့်နေရာကိုယ်ယူခွင့်ရှိတယ်။

text.en: I am worthy of the love I give to others.
text.my: ငါ တခြားသူတွေကို ပေးတဲ့ ချစ်ခြင်းမေတ္တာမျိုးကို ငါလည်း ရထိုက်တယ်။

text.en: I am enough, exactly as I am today.
text.my: ငါဟာ ဒီနေ့ ဒီအတိုင်းပဲ လုံလောက်တယ်။

text.en: I choose to speak to myself like someone I love.
My voice matters and I am proud to use it.
text.my: ငါ့အသံက အရေးပါတယ်၊ အဲဒီအသံကို ထုတ်ဖော်သုံးဖို့လည်း ဂုဏ်ယူတယ်။

text.en: I can do hard things, one soft step at a time.
text.my: ငါ ခက်ခဲတာတွေကို တစ်လှမ်းချင်း နူးနူးညံ့ညံ့ လုပ်ဆောင်နိုင်တယ်။

text.en: I trust myself to figure it out.
text.my: ငါ ကိုယ့်ဘာသာ အဖြေရှာနိုင်မယ်လို့ ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို ယုံကြည်တယ်။

text.en: I am growing, and that is something to celebrate.
text.my: ငါ တဖြည်းဖြည်း ကြီးထွားလာနေတယ်၊ အဲဒါက ဂုဏ်ပြုစရာပါ။

text.en: It is okay to rest. Healing is not a race.
text.my: အနားယူလို့ရတယ်။ ပြန်လည်သက်သာလာတာက ပြိုင်ပွဲမဟုတ်ဘူး။

text.en: My feelings are valid, and they will pass like clouds.
text.my: ငါ့ခံစားချက်တွေက မှန်ကန်တယ်၊ တိမ်တွေလိုပဲ ခဏနေရင် ဖြတ်သွားတတ်တယ်။

text.en: I forgive myself for what I did not know yet.
text.my: ငါ မသိသေးခဲ့တဲ့အရာတွေအတွက် ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို ခွင့်လွှတ်တယ်။

text.en: I am gentle with the girl I used to be.
text.my: ငါ အရင်က မိန်းကလေးဖြစ်ခဲ့တဲ့ ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို နူးညံ့စွာ ဆက်ဆံတယ်။

text.en: I do my best, and my best is allowed to change each day.
I can take breaks without losing my progress.
text.my: ငါ တိုးတက်မှုတွေ မပျောက်ဘဲ ခဏနားလို့ရတယ်။

text.en: My worth is not measured by my productivity.
text.my: ငါ့တန်ဖိုးကို ငါ ဘယ်လောက်အလုပ်ပြီးမြောက်လဲဆိုတာနဲ့ တိုင်းတာလို့မရဘူး။

text.en: My body carries me through every day, and I thank it.
text.my: ငါ့ခန္ဓာကိုယ်က နေ့တိုင်း ငါ့ကို ပံ့ပိုးပေးနေတယ်၊ အဲဒါအတွက် ကျေးဇူးတင်တယ်။

text.en: I nourish myself with kindness first.
text.my: ငါ့ကိုယ်ငါ အရင်ဆုံး ကြင်နာမှုနဲ့ ပြုစုစောင့်ရှောက်တယ်။

text.en: I breathe in softly and let the day settle.
text.my: ငါ နူးနူးညံ့ညံ့ အသက်ရှူသွင်းပြီး တစ်နေ့တာကို ဖြည်းဖြည်းချင်း အေးအေးဆေးဆေး ဖြစ်လာခွင့်ပေးတယ်။

text.en: This moment is safe, and I am right here in it.
text.my: ဒီအခိုက်အတန့်က လုံခြုံတယ်၊ ငါလည်း ဒီအခိုက်အတန့်ထဲမှာ ရှိနေတယ်။

text.en: I am loved, I am held, I am home in myself.
text.my: ငါ့ကို ချစ်ကြတယ်၊ ငါ့ကို ဖေးမထားကြတယ်၊ ငါ့ကိုယ်ငါနဲ့အတူဆို အိမ်မှာလို နွေးထွေးတယ်။

text.en: I deserve the same kindness I give to everyone else.

I can be soft and strong at the same time.

I stand tall and take up my space.

I have something special to offer.
I trust my instincts a little more each day.

I carry my own light wherever I go.

My heart is tender, and I will treat it that way.

Better days are made of small, gentle ones.
I am safe to feel whatever is here right now.
I forgive myself for the things I could not do yet.
I give myself the comfort I would give a friend.
I am allowed to take up space with my feelings.
I do not have to carry everything today.
I am learning what I need, and that is healing too.
Hard moments pass, and I am still here.
I thank myself for getting through today.
I can be kind to the part of me that is hurting.
I allow myself to rest without guilt.
I am worth looking after, always.
My story is still being written, one soft page at a time.
I make room for joy, even in small pieces.
I do not need to rush my healing.
I choose peace over replaying the past.
My heart knows how to heal, and I give it time.
I am allowed to start over as many times as I need.
I honour how much I have felt and grown.
I am proud of myself for staying gentle.
I am surrounded by small comforts, and I notice them.
I hold myself with care today.
I take one slow breath, and then another.
I let go of what I cannot control.
I am calm, even when things around me are loud.
Right now, I have everything I need.
I give my mind permission to rest.
I soften my shoulders and unclench my jaw.
I slow down and find my own rhythm.
I can come back to my breath whenever I need.
There is no need to hurry. I am right on time.
I choose to let this moment be quiet.
I release tension with every slow breath out.
I am grounded and steady.
I let thoughts pass like clouds across the sky.
I deserve a moment of peace today.
I am safe in this moment.
I make space for stillness.
I let my body settle and my heart soften.

I carry a little calm with me everywhere.
I breathe in comfort and breathe out worry.
I do one thing at a time, and that is enough.
I find peace in small, ordinary things.
I let the day end gently.
I am allowed to pause.
My mind is quieting, one breath at a time.
I trust that things will unfold at their own pace.
I give myself a warm, quiet place to rest.
I notice the calm that is already here.
I let my breath lead me home.
I rest, and the world can wait.
I can start small and build from there.
My best today is enough.
I take breaks because I care for my mind.
I learn at my own pace.
I do not have to know everything to begin.
I focus on one task at a time.

I thank my body for carrying me today.
